four_layer_diagnosis.measurement: MISLEADING -- this is the dominant diagnosis layer. experiments/_lib/baselines/mech477_dualsystem_arbitration.py aggregates three non-vacuity statistics (min_full_score_range, min_habit_score_range, min_habit_distinct_frac) with an inconsistent empty-cell default: `float(min(full_ranges)) if full_ranges else 0.0` (and the analogous habit-range/distinct-fraction lines), while the adjacent recruitment_rate field in the SAME function correctly uses `float(np.mean(recruitments)) if recruitments else None`. A cell with zero scored ticks therefore reports an indistinguishable-from-genuine-degeneracy 0.0 for the range/distinctness fields, and the aggregate `_worst()` (a true min-across-cells, by design, to prevent a single out-of-band cell hiding inside a mean) propagates that spurious 0.0 through every level of aggregation, so ANY zero-tick cell anywhere unconditionally zeroes the whole run's readiness verdict for BOTH arms, regardless of how the other 108/128 (84%) cells read.

All always-core recording fields are present (recording_schema=rec/v1, substrate_hash, machine/machine_class, elapsed_seconds, full config, explicit seeds list) -- ree-v3/validate_recording.py would find no gap. The raw per-cell data needed to compute the CORRECT readiness verdict (ticks_scored, min_full_score_range, min_habit_score_range, min_habit_distinct_frac per cell) is already fully present in the manifest for every one of the 108 non-empty cells; the defect is purely in the AGGREGATION FUNCTION's empty-cell default value (0.0 instead of None+exclude), not in what was recorded. targets.recommended_evidence_quality_note: V3-EXQ-811 self-routed substrate_not_ready_requeue (non_degenerate=False, both arms failed full_score_range_non_degenerate / habit_score_range_non_degenerate / habit_score_distinct_fraction) -- THE RUN'S OWN SELF-ROUTE IS REJECTED (confirmed failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-811_2026-07-24). The manifest's non-vacuity gate has an aggregation bug in experiments/_lib/baselines/mech477_dualsystem_arbitration.py: cells with zero scored ticks (20/128, 15.6%, skewed to the novel condition and arb_on) default the range/distinctness fields to 0.0 instead of None (unlike the adjacent recruitment_rate field, which correctly excludes them), and the true-minimum aggregation across all 128 cells propagates that spurious 0.0 regardless of how the other 108 cells read. Re-deriving the same worst-case statistics from the manifest's own per-cell data, excluding only the zero-tick cells, ALL THREE gates clear comfortably (worst full-score-range 0.0022 vs floor 1e-6; worst habit-score-range 9.3e-6 vs floor 1e-6; worst distinct-fraction 0.875 vs floor 0.5) -- fully reproducible from the committed manifest, no new run needed. Once corrected, this is MECH-477's FIRST genuine experimental evidence: C1_recruitment_delta_greater_with_arbitrator passed (6/7 seeds ON greater, Cohen's d 0.999 ON vs -0.158 OFF, robustness bar clears ON / fails OFF), a clean confirmation of the Daw/Niv/Dayan arbitration-by-relative-reliability mechanism this claim translates. Apply supports to MECH-477 (its v3_pending gate should be reconsidered on this evidence). MECH-163 gets NO additional weight from this run (user-confirmed 2026-07-24): the OFF arm's flat response is a necessary control replicating 786a's baseline, not an independent fair test of MECH-163's already-narrowed leg-1 claim -- record as context alongside the existing 786a weakens, not as a second data point against it. The underlying aggregation bug is routed to /queue-experiment as a same-question alphabetic-suffix re-run (V3-EXQ-811a) so a clean manifest exists for future reference, even though 811's own verdict is settled by this re-derivation.
